last_response.name: Black crescent slash
last_response.message: A one-shot black crescent slash, about 0.3 seconds at 32 fps: it whips in from the lower left, sweeps across the frame in a wide arc, and fades out at the lower right, with a bright cyan-white rim and a glowing head with sparks. Side view, transparent background, no characters or text. The flame-like flicker on the edges is only light, so it reads mostly as a sharp black blade with a cold rim; I did not add much flickering to the black body. The sliders are not yet exposed, so adjust the slash by asking for a larger arc or a different colour.
